units.title: Furto
units.note: Encoded by g0 as the worked pattern; owned by g3 from here. Every paragraph: caput and § 3º (the crime, consummated or attempted, art. 14), § 1º (increase), § 2º (privileged: the judge's three options), §§ 4º, 4º-A, 4º-B, 5º to 10 (the qualified forms and their penas cominadas), § 4º-C, § 11 and § 12 (causes of increase). Temporal scope: penalty rules answer for facts from 4.5.2026 (Lei nº 15.397/2026) and refuse for earlier facts, whose wording is not in the source; §§ 10 to 12 apply from 23.9.2026 (Lei nº 15.517/2026). Tests in cp-g3-furto-testes.l4. Forks in g0.forks.json: the reserved F-sweep-b-17 to F-sweep-b-21 (sweep entries M-sweep-b-26 to -30), and F-g0-05, -13, -14, -18 to -21, -23, -25 to -27. The insignificância principle is an input finding (F-sweep-b-21).
